title.zh: 给工作台列一份用品清单

brief.zh: 校准工作台需要 2 卷线缆、3 颗螺丝和 1 把刷子。请 AI 逐项列出物品和数量，然后核对清单。
brief.en: The calibration bench needs 2 cable rolls, 3 screws, and 1 brush. Ask the AI for a checklist that lists the items and their counts, then check it.

concept.zh: 同时写明三种物品、各自数量和交付格式。
concept.en: Name all three items, their counts, and the requested output.

hints.zh: “几卷”和“一些”容易让 AI 猜数量。写出具体数字。
hints.en: Phrases like “a few rolls” leave the count open. Give the exact numbers.

cards.en: Return a checklist with one item per line.

zh: 线缆：2卷。螺丝：3颗。刷子：1把。请交回一份逐项清单。
螺丝改为3颗。其他项目保持原样。
en: Cable rolls: 2. Screws: 3. Brush: 1. Return a checklist with one item per line.
Set screws to 3. Keep the other entries.
